I set the main colour to dark green and added "Nos actions pour la jeunesse" to the portal menu. The form is valid.

- **Main colour:** `#1B5E20`, a dark green. The portal is in simplified colour mode, so I set it in the "Couleur principale" field of the default theme. The other palettes (dark, high contrast) are recalculated from it when the draft is saved, so those will change too. I chose the exact shade myself; tell me if you had a specific green in mind.
- **Menu:** a new item at the end of the navigation bar, of type "Page libre", pointing to the page `jeunesse` ("Nos actions pour la jeunesse"). Its label is "Nos actions pour la jeunesse". I left the "new tab", icon and colour options unset.
